bar-title.purpose: The page title in the top strip; 22px at >= 900px.

section.purpose: Wall section headings and the tank-pick heading.

sticker-name.purpose: The pet's name on the price sticker; 19px at <= 360px.

sticker-age.purpose: The day number on the price sticker.

sticker-small.purpose: The sticker kind line (tank and stage) and the age words.

body.purpose: Page text; the care sheet runs 15px / 1.7.

tool-label.purpose: The word under each drawn tool on the shelf.

label.purpose: Tray notes, food sub-lines, binder descriptions.

card-head.purpose: The index card heading, on the 28px rule.

card-row.purpose: Index card rows and notes, on the 28px rule.

say.purpose: The handwritten line under the tools saying what just happened; 17px at >= 900px.

shadows.name: tank-on-wall
shadows.purpose: The whole tank, lid to base, on the wall.

shadows.name: shelf-edge
shadows.purpose: The shelf board's front face and shadow under the tools (0 6px 0 under the tank, 0 5px 0 under each shelf tank). The shelf's thickness, not a card shadow.

shadows.name: taped-paper
shadows.purpose: Price sticker, call flag and play score slip.

shadows.name: index-card
shadows.purpose: The index card, with two clear tape strips rgba(255,255,255,.42).

shadows.name: tray
shadows.purpose: The feed tray dropped from the lid.

shadows.name: lens
shadows.purpose: The magnifier rim and its shadow.

shadows.name: poster
shadows.purpose: Binder and care-sheet posters on the wall.

motion.name: lamp-dim
motion.purpose: Lamp off: night overlay in, wall, card, tools and strip dimmed together.

motion.name: lamp-flicker
motion.purpose: Lamp on: fluorescent start-up of the tube and the night overlay.

motion.name: food-drop
motion.value: 900ms: fall cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45) to 72 %, one bounce, rotate 250deg
motion.purpose: Food through the lid; the pet then walks over at 120px/s and chomps for 1.3s.

motion.name: hatch
motion.purpose: The lid hatch tips open while something comes through the lid.

motion.name: tray-drop
motion.purpose: The feed tray coming down from the lid.

motion.name: knock
motion.purpose: A knuckle knock on the glass when play starts.

motion.name: scoop
motion.purpose: The scoop sweeping the substrate; each poop flicks away over 260ms as it passes.

motion.name: spray
motion.purpose: Grooming mist drifting onto the pet.

motion.name: sticker-slap
motion.purpose: A new price sticker after hatching or evolving.

motion.name: evolve-fog
motion.purpose: The glass fogs and the pet whites out before the new sticker.

motion.name: lens-open
motion.purpose: The magnifier opening in the glass.

motion.name: pet-walk
motion.value: hop .42s steps(2,jump-none); distance / 64px per s linear
motion.purpose: The pet wandering every 2.6s when free.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every effect is skipped or placed instantly.

narrative.northStar: The Tank on the Shop Shelf
narrative.overview:
The pet lives in a real glass tank on a dim pet-shop wall. The tank has a black plastic lid with a fluorescent tube in it, black side rims, a faint green glass edge, two slanted reflection streaks and a black base. Below it runs a grey shelf board. The six fields are six kinds of tank: a sand terrarium, an aquarium, a tall perch cage, a bamboo rainforest tank, a warm-lamp tropical tank and a frosted freezer case. Each tank's habitat is drawn in natural materials. The tank's lamp is the main light on the page: it spills a soft glow onto the wall behind the tank, and switching it off darkens the tank, the wall, the card, the tools and the top strip together, leaving a small amber night light in the corner.

Care is done to the tank, never through stat bars. Food drops through the lid, falls, bounces on the substrate and the pet walks over to eat it. A knuckle knocks on the glass to start play. A scoop comes down through the lid and sweeps out the poop. A spray bottle mists the pet. The lamp is a rocker switch. State is shown as marks and materials. On the yellow index card, pencil ticks fill four boxes for hunger and mood, and 正-stroke tallies count tornadoes, rice balls and suns. Dirt shows as darkened substrate. Illness shows as fogged glass, and a pet turned devil fogs the glass further and gets horns. Evolution fogs the glass, whites out the pet, and then slaps a new price sticker onto the glass.

Confirmed rejections (direction contract): the egg-shaped LCD device with three buttons, and the cartoon-room app with stat bars. The characters are original and drawn as flat colour planes without outlines. No Bandai names, sprites or logos.
keyCharacteristics: One dim teal shop wall with a peg-board dot grid, lit by the tank's own lamp.
A black-rimmed glass tank about 55 % of the phone screen tall, on a shelf board with a hard front edge.
A fluorescent-orange price sticker on the glass (tank, stage, name, age) and a yellow ruled index card taped under the tank, written in pencil (Iansui).
Seven drawn tools standing on the shelf edge: 餵食, 陪玩, 清理, 保養, the lamp switch, 吃藥 and 放大鏡.
Field colours appear only as label bands (shelf tanks, binder sections) and, in the magnifier, as cell fills.
Every care act has a physical animation, and every one has an instant path under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: The tank's lamp is the light source. Turning it off dims everything that sits in its light (wall, card, tools, top strip, sticker) and turns on the amber night light; nothing on the page stays lit on its own.

rules.name: The Field Band Rule
rules.body: A field colour labels a tank or a binder section. It never fills a panel, a button or text.

rules.name: The Orange Means Now Rule
rules.body: Sticker orange marks the current pet and what it is asking for. Don't use it for decoration or for a second meaning.

rules.name: The Print and Pencil Rule
rules.body: What the shop prints (labels, keys, posters) is Chiron GoRound TC. What the keeper writes (the card, the game slip, the say line) is Iansui. Don't mix them on one surface.

rules.name: The Card Rule Rule
rules.body: Every line on the index card sits on the 28px ruling: headings, rows and notes all use a 28px line height.

rules.name: The Real Objects Rule
rules.body: Only things that exist in the shop cast shadows: the tank, the shelf, the taped paper, the trays and posters. Text and icons never get glows or shadows.

dos: **Do** keep every care verb a physical act on the tank (through the lid, on the glass, at the switch), with an instant reduced-motion path.
**Do** show the pet's state as pencil marks on the card and as material changes in the tank (fog, dark substrate, dark poop), not as bars or warning icons.
**Do** let the lamp switch darken the tank and everything in its light together, and flicker on in `steps()`.
**Do** draw new characters with `spr()` as flat colour planes without outlines, in two or three colours.
**Do** keep field colours to label bands and cell fills, with white text on bands.
**Do** keep handwriting (Iansui) on the keeper's paper and Chiron GoRound TC on everything printed.
**Do** open every overlay inside the glass and keep keys at 44px or larger.
donts: **Don't** add stat bars, percentages on screen, or an egg-shaped LCD device.
**Don't** use sticker orange for anything but the current pet and its call.
**Don't** give text or icons glows or shadows; shadows belong to the tank, the shelf, taped paper, trays and posters.
**Don't** use Bandai names, sprites or logos for any character.
